name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Either Governess goes with Cellar or Maid goes with Pierce.
Fairfax goes with either Ballroom or Kitchen.
Exactly one of these is true: Blackwood goes with Maid; Holloway goes with Cellar; Ballroom goes with Governess.
Between Cellar and Doctor, one goes with Blackwood and the other with Crane.
If Library goes with Maid, then either Ballroom goes with Holloway or Kitchen does not go with Doctor (but not both).
Doctor, Heir, and Maid go with Crane, Library, and Lounge, in some order.
Either Library goes with Crane or Cellar goes with Valet.
